name: Nathan Pesch
bio:
## Engineer, gamedev, music producer.

Madly in love with computing and creating since I was 12 years old. 

Studied a Bachelor's in Computer Science and Master's in Engineering at the Free university of Brussels, working at McKinsey & Company as a consultant/analyst.

Born 13th of July 2000.

projects.title: Adventurelands
projects.description: Mobile pixel-art RPG with reaction-time based combat, inventory management and dynamically scaling procedurally generated levels.

projects.title: Master's thesis: Performing Standardized Fall Risk Tests using Virtual Reality
projects.description:
Virtual Reality application for fall risk detection in realistic, unfamiliar environments. State of the art motion event detection algorithm based on internal HMD sensor data, no external measuring units.
- Consulted with clinical professionals to conduct needs analysis, define clinical requirements, and translate them into a technical product roadmap for a realistic VR balance testing application.
- Led a team of physiotherapists to perform lab testing with volunteers. 
- Managed full project lifecycle from concept to deployment, incorporating iterative user feedback to ensure the final VR application met critical medical standards and was user-friendly for non-technical experts. 
- Successfully deployed the application in clinical settings, providing an automated & standardized solution to a previously manual medical assessment process.
